spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Black Lantern is still carrying traffic. Now it carries our shadow with it.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: You gave Morrow a map made of people. Make sure he remembers what the symbols mean.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: You protected the couriers and destroyed the only clean path upward. Iris calls that mercy. I call it an expensive preference.

spoken_lines.speaker: Iris
spoken_lines.text: Mara remembers one apartment now. Her own. That will have to count as a victory.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: The freight yard still treats Pair Seven as an internal failure. No public description, no bounty. Clean work.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Freight security circulated your description. Black Lantern knows the route was attacked, even if it does not know what survived.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Whatever lead we kept or lost, the couriers were never infrastructure.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: No. They were leverage. Our disagreement is whether destroying the leverage removes the hand holding it.

spoken_lines.speaker: V
spoken_lines.text: Morita is still out there. This only changes how we find him.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Correct. You changed the route, not the destination. We adapt.

spoken_lines.speaker: Morrow
spoken_lines.text: Payment transferred. Keep the channel open. Black Lantern was a route, not the destination.

spoken_lines.speaker: Patch
spoken_lines.text: Should've told you what I knew. Next time I sell confidence, ask what I'm using as collateral.
